dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Lately, we've had reports of some guy wearing an eyepatch. He's been standing at the entrance to Tete Isle and impersonating our bartenders.

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: It's weird. Even though he's not one of our guys, he's always recommending our drinks to the guests. And he's doing this for free... Maybe he's just a fan?

dialogues.speaker: Tlapalli
dialogues.text: Anyway, there's no need for you to worry about that. I'll track down this kindly "bartender" and find out what his deal is.
